title: Office & Commercial Movers in Burbank | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Commercial movers in Burbank for landlord COIs, loading-dock slots and staged weekend moves, with hourly crews working Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM.
heroSubtitle: Office suites, studio-side workspaces and airport-area flex buildings moved to your landlord's rules, any day of the week from 8AM to 6PM

faq.question: Does our Burbank office need a city permit for the truck at the curb?
faq.answer: Only when the truck has to stand on the street; a building dock needs no city permit. Curb space is covered by a Public Works Street Use Permit, and a weekend move also needs approval from the Public Works Director. After the walkthrough we tell you whether your address needs one and give you the truck details for the application.

faq.question: Our landlord wants a certificate of insurance before move day. Can you provide one?
faq.answer: Yes. We issue a COI for $50 with the additional-insured names your building specifies, as towers such as The Tower on W. Alameda Avenue require from anyone using their dock. Send us the landlord's requirements as soon as your date is set, and we deliver the certificate to the management office ahead of the move.

faq.question: Can you move our office on a Saturday or Sunday?
faq.answer: Yes. Weekends are regular working days for our crews, always between 8AM and 6PM. Larger offices are usually split so one stage runs over a weekend while staff are away, and since Friday – Sunday rates are higher, we put less urgent loads on weekdays when your schedule allows.

faq.question: How is the price of a Burbank office move worked out?
faq.answer: Hourly. Two movers with a truck start at $119 an hour cash, Monday to Thursday, and bigger crews cost more. Every job has a 3-hour minimum, plus $30 for gas and, if you need them, a $50 COI or a $200 second truck. You get a firm quote after we walk through the space.

faq.question: Do you move warehouse and stockroom contents near the airport?
faq.answer: Yes: shelving units, stock cartons and the office furniture that goes with them. On campuses such as Avion Burbank, where office and industrial buildings share one site, we quote the stock area and the front office as a single job. Hazardous materials are the exception, and we send the list of items we cannot carry during planning.

faq.question: Can a small Burbank office be moved on the day we call?
faq.answer: Often, yes, when a crew and truck are free that day. A small suite with a dock or an easy curb suits a same-day move best, because a weekend street permit or a management-office booking takes time to arrange. Phoning 909-443-0004 before noon gives the best odds.
